device.title: This device
device.note: Kept by this browser, not in your matrix file. Other devices keep their own.

startOver.note: Disconnects this device from your ideas file but does not delete it. You can reconnect to the file later. This can be useful when using a shared computer.
startOver.title: Start over on this device?
startOver.body: Your matrix file stays exactly where it is, on this computer or in your Google Drive, with everything in it. This only clears what the app remembers here: which file was open, the Google sign-in, the cached copy, the language choice and the tour. The next visit starts at the welcome screen, and you can open the same file again from there.

where.title: Where your ideas live
where.explain: Opening a different file switches to it; the current file stays where it is with everything saved. Moving copies your matrix to the new place and switches to the copy; the old file is left untouched.
where.needsChromeLong: Moving to this computer needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.
where.dropboxLater: Dropbox is coming in a later version.
where.signOutExplain: Signing out drops the key Google gave the app; the next read or save asks for one click.

name.title: Matrix name
name.label: Shown at the top of the matrix

export.title: Export
export.explain: Downloads a copy in the chosen format. JSON is the matrix file itself, complete with the evidence log; Markdown is for reading; CSV is one row per idea for a spreadsheet.

privacy.title: Privacy and trust
privacy.text: Nothing leaves your machine except to the storage you chose. You can check that yourself: open your browser’s developer tools, watch the Network tab while you edit, and see that the only traffic is the page itself.
